entities.summary: Stasys Šalkauskis was a Lithuanian Catholic philosopher, educator, and rector of Vytautas Magnus University. The Stasys Šalkauskis Prize was established in 1991 to honor outstanding figures in science, art, and national culture from the Šiauliai region.
